description: IRS Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), Beneficiary's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc., the income statement an estate or trust issues to each beneficiary. One page.

tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form header, e.g. 2025

tax_period_beginning.description: Tax year beginning date as printed, MM/DD/YYYY; null if blank

tax_period_ending.description: Tax year ending date as printed, MM/DD/YYYY; null if blank

final_k1.description: True if the Final K-1 box at the top is checked

amended_k1.description: True if the Amended K-1 box at the top is checked

estate_or_trust.description: Part I, Information About the Estate or Trust

ein.description: Item A, the estate's or trust's employer identification number, as NN-NNNNNNN

name.description: Item B, the estate's or trust's name (first line only)

address.description: Item B, the street address, city, state and ZIP printed after the name

fiduciary_name_and_address.description: Item C, the fiduciary's name and address; null if blank

form_1041t_filed.description: Item D, true if the Form 1041-T box is checked

form_1041t_date.description: Item D, the date Form 1041-T was filed; null if blank

final_form_1041.description: Item E, true if the box marking this as the final Form 1041 for the estate or trust is checked

beneficiary.description: Part II, Information About the Beneficiary

identifying_number.description: Item F, the beneficiary's identifying number (SSN or TIN)

name.description: Item G, the beneficiary's name (first line only)

address.description: Item G, the street address, city, state and ZIP printed after the name

domestic.description: Item H, true if the Domestic beneficiary box is checked

foreign.description: Item H, true if the Foreign beneficiary box is checked

income.description: Part III, boxes 1 to 10: the beneficiary's share of current year income and deductions. Amounts as numbers without commas; null when the box is blank.

other_portfolio_and_nonbusiness_income.description: Box 5, other portfolio and nonbusiness income

net_rental_real_estate_income.description: Box 7, net rental real estate income

final_year_deductions.description: Box 11, final year deductions: one entry per code letter and amount printed in the box. Empty if the box is blank.

code.description: The code letter printed in box 11, e.g. A

amount.description: The amount printed beside the code in box 11, as a number without commas

amt_adjustments.description: Box 12, alternative minimum tax adjustment: one entry per code letter and amount printed in the box. Empty if the box is blank.

code.description: The code letter printed in box 12, e.g. A

amount.description: The amount printed beside the code in box 12, as a number without commas

credits.description: Box 13, credits and credit recapture: one entry per code letter and amount printed in the box. Empty if the box is blank.

code.description: The code letter printed in box 13, e.g. A

amount.description: The amount printed beside the code in box 13, as a number without commas

other_information.description: Box 14, other information: one entry per code letter and amount printed in the box. Empty if the box is blank.

code.description: The code letter printed in box 14, e.g. A

amount.description: The amount printed beside the code in box 14, as a number without commas
